Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0076", "row_sha256": "05eea58c222de6e554ff0c6a40d39772f0dff5ae57f8ccf59e6677b91ed8edca", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm recording the update for our shared bicycle shed before saturday's meeting um on thursday morning the west door was sticking and it took two tries to latch it i checked the hinge and the frame but i haven't worked out what is causing it first the motion light near the entrance came on normally second the rack by the drain is still loose and needs a washer the blue cargo bike belongs in the marked space by the back wall nina asked me whether the painted strip has to stay empty and i said yes it marks the route to the rear gate please remind everyone not to leave helmets or delivery boxes there i also found a red scarf on the bench and put it in the clear lost property tub on the shelf if somebody knows whose it is they can collect it at the meeting the tap by the side entrance is still turned off and i don't know when the plumber will come so bring a bottle of water if you plan to clean your bike i can bring the small tool kit but not the floor pump because its hose is split we'll check the door and the loose rack together on saturday and write down anything else that needs attention", "output": "I'm recording the update for our shared bicycle shed before Saturday's meeting. On Thursday morning, the west door was sticking, and it took two tries to latch it. I checked the hinge and the frame, but I haven't worked out what is causing it.

First, the motion light near the entrance came on normally. Second, the rack by the drain is still loose and needs a washer. The blue cargo bike belongs in the marked space by the back wall. Nina asked me whether the painted strip has to stay empty, and I said yes, it marks the route to the rear gate. Please remind everyone not to leave helmets or delivery boxes there.

I also found a red scarf on the bench and put it in the clear lost property tub on the shelf. If somebody knows whose it is, they can collect it at the meeting. The tap by the side entrance is still turned off, and I don't know when the plumber will come, so bring a bottle of water if you plan to clean your bike. I can bring the small tool kit, but not the floor pump because its hose is split. We'll check the door and the loose rack together on Saturday and write down anything else that needs attention."}]
